column2: Fifteen thousand properties. One Monday board. Finding the right one used to take hours.
Meet the Nova Havens Property Map.
Press Command K. Every claim waiting on housing, one keystroke away. Pick one, and the map jumps straight to the family's home.
Every property nearby, priced right on the map. Filter for pets, photos, or listed rent.
Tap one to see if it fits the family, and exactly what it costs to move in.
Add it to the claim, and it's on Monday, distance and all.
Shortlist ready? Send it. One click copies a clean summary, opens an email to the relocation specialist, and logs it on the claim.
Pick. Find. Add. Send. The Nova Havens Property Map.
